iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

GTP::message
       Returns the entire GTP message.

SYNOPSIS
       GTP::message ('-message' MESSAGE)?

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the entire GTP message.

       Syntax

       GTP::message

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when GTP_SIGNALLING_INGRESS {
	    set t1 [GTP::message]
	    log local0. "GTP type [GTP::header type -message $t1]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.5.0 --First introduced the command.
